title: Amaziah's Reign

questions.question: Who reigned in Joash's place?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:1 (ESV): "Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: What did Amaziah do to the servants who had killed his father?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:3 (ESV): "...he killed his servants who had struck down the king his father."

questions.question: Why did he not put their children to death?
options: According to what is written in the Law of Moses: fathers shall not die for the children
questions.correctAnswer: According to what is written in the Law of Moses: fathers shall not die for the children
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:4 (ESV): "But he did not put their children to death, according to what is written in the Law..."

questions.question: Who did Amaziah hire to help him in battle?
options: 100,000 mighty men of valor from Israel
questions.correctAnswer: 100,000 mighty men of valor from Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:6 (ESV): "He hired also 100,000 mighty men of valor from Israel..."

questions.question: Why did the man of God tell him not to take the army of Israel?
options: For the LORD is not with Israel
questions.correctAnswer: For the LORD is not with Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:7 (ESV): "...for the LORD is not with Israel..."

questions.question: What did Amaziah do with the hired soldiers from Ephraim?
options: He discharged them to go to their home
questions.correctAnswer: He discharged them to go to their home
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:10 (ESV): "So Amaziah discharged the troops that had come to him from Ephraim..."

questions.question: How did the discharged soldiers react?
options: Their anger was greatly kindled against Judah
questions.correctAnswer: Their anger was greatly kindled against Judah
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:10 (ESV): "...And their anger was greatly kindled against Judah..."

questions.question: Who did Amaziah defeat in the Valley of Salt?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:11 (ESV): "...and went to the Valley of Salt and struck down 10,000 men of Seir."

questions.question: What did Amaziah do after slaughtering the Edomites?
options: He brought the gods of the men of Seir and set them up as his gods
He built an altar to God
questions.correctAnswer: He brought the gods of the men of Seir and set them up as his gods
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:14 (ESV): "...he brought the gods of the men of Seir and set them up as his gods..."

questions.question: Who challenged Amaziah to face him in battle?
options: Amaziah challenged Joash king of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: Amaziah challenged Joash king of Israel
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:17 (ESV): "Then Amaziah... sent messengers to Joash... saying, 'Come, let us look one another in the face.'"

questions.question: How did Joash reply to the challenge?
options: With a parable about a thistle and a cedar
questions.correctAnswer: With a parable about a thistle and a cedar
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:18 (ESV): "And Joash king of Israel sent word... 'A thistle on Lebanon sent to a cedar on Lebanon...'"

questions.question: Why did God overlook Amaziah's defeat by Joash?
options: For it was from God, that he might give them into the hand of their enemies
questions.correctAnswer: For it was from God, that he might give them into the hand of their enemies
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:20 (ESV): "...for it was from God, that he might give them into the hand of their enemies, because they had sought the gods of Edom."

questions.question: What did Joash break down in Jerusalem?
options: The wall of Jerusalem for 400 cubits
questions.correctAnswer: The wall of Jerusalem for 400 cubits
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:23 (ESV): "...and broke down the wall of Jerusalem... 400 cubits."

questions.question: How did Amaziah die?
options: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish, but they killed him there
questions.correctAnswer: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish, but they killed him there
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:27 (ESV): "...they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem, and he fled to Lachish. But they sent after him to Lachish and put him to death there."

questions.question: What did the prophet say when Amaziah silenced him?
options: I know that God has determined to destroy you
questions.correctAnswer: I know that God has determined to destroy you
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:16 (ESV): "...Then the prophet stopped, but said, 'I know that God has determined to destroy you...'"

key_verse_text: And Amaziah said to the man of God, “But what shall we do for the hundred talents that I have given to the army of Israel?” The man of God answered, “The LORD is able to give you much more than this.”
